action_items: FIX ProfileCard.jsx overlay positioning: either (a) move the absolute name/distance overlay INSIDE the aspect-[3/4] image div so `bottom-0` is anchored to the image bottom (recommended), or (b) add `pointer-events-none` to the overlay div (line ~39 of ProfileCard.jsx: `<div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 p-3 text-white">`). Option (a) is cleanest since the overlay should visually sit at the bottom of the image, not the whole card. The gradient div already has pointer-events-none but the text overlay does not.
After fix, re-verify: like button click keeps card and shows '✓ Лайкнуто' disabled; pass button click removes card; both via UI click (no force).
